40:2382.en: 「$$チェーン$$ tuned it.\nI can win...!」

At this range, this'll do it!

40:3356.en: 「An empty vessel in a mask? Useless!」

40:3399.en: 「A mere fake posing as the $$赤い彗星$$!」

40:3525.en: 「$$ハマーン$$! What are you fighting for?!」

40:3882.en: 「Even with a $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$!」

40:3919.en: 「If I can just sense the force field!」

40:3944.en: 「If we must fight to mutual ruin...!」

40:3987.en: 「What is this?\nI sense something like a will...!」

40:4077.en: 「Until we can understand each other,\nI won't abandon hope!」

40:4212.en: 「I won't let you have your way!」

40:4278.en: 「I'll beat you,\nand end this mad war!」

40:4468.en: 「Even the power of a $$スフィア$$\ncan't be invincible...!」

40:4519.en: 「Whoever you are, if you oppose us...!」

40:4560.en: 「We've already reached a point where\nwe can't coexist with you...!」

40:4617.en: 「I won't hand over the future...!\nThat's why I fight!」

40:4666.en: 「People who can only look down\non others...!」

40:4730.en: 「I'll hit them before they get away!」
alternatives: Hit them before they can withdraw!
I'll hit you before you can escape!
Hit them before they can escape!

40:5043.en: 「That's $$プリベンター$$ Wind for you!」

40:5082.en: 「I'll use my machine as a shield!」

40:5103.en: 「Fight like that, the dead take you!」

40:5171.en: 「$$クェス$$, take a good look around!」
